## About
Frankel Design Build is a family-owned custom home builder based in Houston, Texas. Scott and Kevin Frankel, both third-generation builders, lead the company as co-presidents.
We keep every part of the process under one roof: architecture, construction, interior design, land acquisition, pools and outdoor living, home care and warranty. That means you work with one team from the first sketch to the years you spend living in the house.
Our homes are built to LEED for Homes standards, so they are more energy-efficient and more sustainable than conventionally built homes. Stop by our studio on Washington Ave or give us a call during the week.

## Services
- Architecture and construction: Custom home design and building, handled by our own architects and builders.
- Interior design: Help choosing finishes and furnishings so the inside of your home fits how you live.
- Land acquisition: Help finding and securing the right lot for your new home.
- Pools and outdoor living: Pools and outdoor spaces designed alongside the rest of your home.
- Home care and warranty: Ongoing care and warranty support after you move in.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need to hire a separate architect or designer?
A: No. Architecture, construction and interior design are all done in-house by our team.

Q: Are your homes energy-efficient?
A: Yes. We build all of our homes to LEED for Homes standards.
